QuestInfo.name: Enemy Mastermind
QuestInfo.0: Maybe the Sacred Stone was already taken somewhere else. Look for something that could be a clue.
QuestInfo.1: Find any clues that you can at the enemy base and then return to #p3000000#. You should search as deep within the enemy base as you can get.
QuestInfo.2: The mastermind was Magnus! Judging by the conversation between Magnus and the enemy commander, Magnus plans to launch an invasion soon.
